title: ARIS accepted to the NeurIPS NEmo Workshop
text: Shared the acceptance of ARIS: Agentic and Relationship Intelligence System for Social Robots, built on the GINNY and IRIS projects.

title: Open PhD position in social robot interaction
text: Announced an open PhD position for research on long-term human–robot social interactions at Monash University.

title: Representing GINNY at the Matheson Society lunch
text: Shared reflections from representing the GINNY Project at Monash University's Matheson Society lunch.

title: Presenting GINNY to Australian American Leadership Dialogue delegates
text: Shared a GINNY presentation to delegates from the Australian American Leadership Dialogue, with support from Monash University and the Monash AI Institute.

title: Started a PhD at Monash University
text: Announced starting a PhD in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence focused on long-term human–robot social interactions and the GINNY Project.

title: Presenting GINNY at PAX Australia
text: Shared the opportunity to present Monash Information Technology's GINNY Project at PAX Australia.

title: GINNY presented during the Monash–Firstsource MoU signing
text: Shared the presentation of the GINNY Project to Firstsource and Victorian Minister Danny Pearson during the Monash University MoU signing.
